Welcome to the Systems Architecture undergraduate course.

This course follows *System Architecture: Strategy and Product Development for Complex Systems* by Edward Crawley, Bruce Cameron, and Daniel Selva (Pearson, 2016). Lecture slides for each chapter are linked in the sidebar.
